summary: SABESP furnished a Form 6-K containing its 3Q26 earnings release dated November 5, 2026, the US-equivalent of a routine quarterly results announcement for a foreign private issuer. Reported figures include 3Q26 core EPS of R$0.31 versus R$0.38 a year earlier, adjusted net revenue up 9.0% y/y, adjusted EBITDA up 13.8% y/y, adjusted net income down 13.8% y/y on a weaker financial result, and R$4.5bn quarterly capex with R$12bn year-to-date. A R$44.2bn contracted capex backlog and universalization targets were cited. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed; no special-situation event to trade.
